title: CAD Agent system design
summary: The NestJS CAD Agent is a lightweight control plane: it validates requests, creates one durable edit_jobs row, and replays progress. It performs no CAD reasoning or source mutation itself — the Python Agent 3D worker claims the job and does everything else.

nodes.label: CAD Clients
nodes.description: CLI or application clients submit one request over WebSocket and optionally follow replayable progress or poll HTTP status.

details.responsibility: Submit a request, retain its client_request_id and job ID, and acknowledge the latest progress sequence received.

nodes.label: CAD Edits Gateway
nodes.description: The only entry point for CAD and linked-mesh conversations: WebSocket submit, subscribe, unsubscribe, and ack.

details.responsibility: Parse and validate submissions, route linked mesh parts to mesh generation, hand CAD requests to SubmissionService, and replay/stream durable progress per connected client.
guarantees: A WebSocket connection is never the workflow's source of truth; disconnecting never cancels a job.
Replay uses a per-subscription high watermark, so reconnecting with after_sequence never re-delivers or skips events.
Events sent to a client are milestones only — never prompts, source bodies, or private model reasoning.

nodes.label: CAD Edits Controller
nodes.description: GET /v1/cad-edits/:jobId serves the same durable job and event history over plain HTTP.

details.responsibility: Read-only durable status and bounded event replay for clients that are not holding a live WebSocket.
guarantees: after_sequence must be a non-negative safe integer or the request is rejected before any lookup.

nodes.label: Submission Service
nodes.description: Turns a validated CAD request into one idempotent durable edit_jobs row.

details.responsibility: Resolve and validate project/part linkage, then create or return the existing job for a repeated client_request_id.
guarantees: Reusing client_request_id with different request content is rejected rather than silently accepted.

nodes.label: Mesh Generation Service
nodes.description: Handles linked mesh-type parts entirely inside Nest; it never enters the CAD edit_jobs workflow.

details.responsibility: Generate an updated mesh part and queue its export when the submitted part_id resolves to part_type = mesh.
guarantees: A mesh part never reaches SubmissionService, Agent 3D, or edit_jobs — the gateway branches before either is called.

nodes.label: Progress Service
nodes.description: Polls edit_job_events on an interval and fans new sequences out to whichever connected clients are subscribed.

details.responsibility: Turn durable database rows into live push events without a in-memory job queue or per-request polling by clients.
guarantees: One RPC batch covers up to 100 subscribed jobs with an independent cursor per job, so one noisy job cannot starve another's delivery.

nodes.label: Edit Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres edit_jobs and edit_job_events are the entire durable handoff between Nest and the Python worker — no nested tool queue exists anymore.

details.responsibility: Own request identity, worker lease, private history checkpoints, ordered public events, and terminal outcome for one CAD edit.
durableWrites: status, state, worker lease, and attempt_count
history checkpoints: goal, high-level plan, and step transitions

nodes.label: Agent 3D (Python)
nodes.description: A separate horizontally-scaled Python service claims the job and owns everything from goal creation through canonical commit.

details.responsibility: Create the goal and plan, run the Agent3D reasoning loop against an edit-scoped candidate, then validate, commit, reindex, and queue export.
guarantees: Nest never calls OpenAI, never sees CAD source, and never decides commit — this worker does.
A linked part_id is reserved before any model call, so replicas add parallelism across parts, not concurrent mutation of one part.

response.label: job snapshot and events since after_sequence

details.summary: Checked before SubmissionService is ever called; a mesh part never becomes an edit_jobs row.
The same worker heartbeats the lease and writes every state update, history checkpoint, and public event for this job as it runs — there is no separate handoff row.

edges.label: poll edit_job_events since last delivered sequence
publish new sequences to matching subscriptions

details.summary: Terminal events (job.completed / job.failed) end the subscription and stop polling for that job.

boundaries.label: NestJS CAD Agent (thin control plane)
boundaries.description: Owns request validation, idempotent job creation, linked-mesh generation, and durable-progress replay. It owns no CAD reasoning, no source mutation, and no commit authority.
